name: Anime Game Design Workflow
description: Structured workflow for developing an anime-style game, covering concept art, character design, world building, narrative scripting, and gameplay mechanics.

phases.title: Concept & Core Vision
phases.detail: Define the high-level concept, target audience, and unique selling points of the game.

phases.title: World Building & Setting
phases.detail: Design the game world with lore, factions, locations, magic/supernatural systems, and history.

phases.title: Character Design
phases.detail: Develop character profiles including backstories, personalities, abilities, and visual design notes.

phases.title: Narrative Structure
phases.detail: Outline the main story arcs, branching paths, dialogue trees, and script structure.

phases.title: Gameplay Mechanics
phases.detail: Design combat systems, progression loops, economy, UI/UX considerations, and core mechanics.

phases.title: Asset Planning
phases.detail: Identify all required assets (art, audio, 3D models) and production timeline.

phases.title: Script & Dialogue
phases.detail: Write and localize dialogue scripts, voice lines, and narration text.

phases.title: Technical Implementation
phases.detail: Plan engine integration, level scripting, system architecture, and performance targets.
